about.en: PYR is the utility token of Vulcan Forged, a blockchain game studio, NFT marketplace and dApp incubator (its platform now runs as VulcanX), used for in-game purchases, marketplace fees and staking across its ecosystem. It is an ERC-20 at 0x430EF9263E76DAE63c84292C3409D61c598E9682, the same address on Ethereum and Polygon PoS.
